evidence.logicalIdentityRed: Request has required Uuid CommandId implementing new IIdentifiedRequest. HTTP handler context RequestId was a different generated UUID.
evidence.current: RequestDispatchContext.Metadata is immutable; copy constructor already preserves ExecutionId/StartedAt. Direct and parent helpers, HTTP/MCP and Fitz producer helpers currently generate logical IDs. Serialized wire metadata is explicit.

state.design: Add opt-in IIdentifiedRequest getter mapping required typed input to stable RequestId. Add explicit metadata factory for source requests/children. Bind a receiver-created context immutably, preserving ExecutionId/StartedAt, and reject empty typed identity or mismatched explicit propagated metadata as Validation before handler work. Root auto metadata can be replaced from typed value; incoming carried metadata cannot be silently overwritten. Direct/HTTP/MCP/queue/RPC/reaction producers/receivers use this shared contract; requests without it retain existing semantics. JSON route/body duplicates must agree by the same typed serializer/converters, allowing omitted body fields. No domain deduplication/receipts are provided by Portia.
state.scope: No security host profile, defaults, existing PR166, domain behavior, deployment or environment reset. New APIs in Unshipped. Proof through consumer/dispatch/transport tests plus full suite/CI.

contract.instructions: Which approach best meets explicit client operation identity across this framework boundary?

criteria.typed_contract: An opt-in typed identity interface, shared context/metadata binding and exact propagated identity validation; domain owners still resolve retries.
criteria.property_convention: Guess a property named CommandId or Id through reflection at each transport.
criteria.attempt_identity: Continue creating a fresh logical request ID for every delivery attempt.

propagated.instructions: When a typed request identity differs from its carried queue/RPC metadata RequestId, what behavior follows the required contract?

criteria.reject: Return/classify validation before handler work, preserving correlation/causation and never silently accepting a different carried key.
criteria.overwrite: Silently rewrite carried metadata to match the payload.
criteria.regenerate: Choose another server UUID and run the command under it.
